title: Conversion Markup on a Hotel Rate Plans Departure Balance
content:
Whether a conversion markup is added to the balance settled at departure on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation turns on the currency the room money on the reservation was presented in and on whether the rate plan booked carries a conversion markup at all.

## The rule

1. Where the room money on this reservation was presented to the guest in a currency other than the US dollar and the rate plan booked carries a currency conversion markup, that markup is added to the balance.
2. Where the room money was presented in a currency other than the US dollar and the rate plan booked carries no currency conversion markup, no conversion markup is added.
3. Where the room money was presented in US dollars, no conversion markup is added.

The currency looked to is the one carried by the most recent room line posted on the reservation. A plan carries a conversion markup where the markup it records stands above nothing.

## The markup each plan carries

| Rate plan | Currency conversion markup, percent | Carries such a markup |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 3.5 | yes |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 3.5 | yes |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 3.0 | yes |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 3.0 | yes |
| Member Flex Rate | 2.5 | yes |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 2.5 | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 2.0 | yes |

## The combinations

| Currency the room money was presented in | Plan carries a conversion markup | Markup added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| other than the US dollar | yes | the markup the plan carries |
| other than the US dollar | no | none |
| US dollars | either way | none |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A balance of 1,580.00 USD before any markup:

- Where the room money was presented in a currency other than the US dollar on the Semi-Flexible Rate, the markup added is 3.0 percent and the balance becomes 1,627.40 USD.
- On the All-Inclusive Flex Rate in the same circumstances, the markup added is 2.0 percent and the balance becomes 1,611.60 USD.
- Where the room money was presented in US dollars, the balance stands at 1,580.00 USD on either plan.
